description: Read what needs the signed-in member or is waiting on them, their ranked "Needs you" list: the findings, pull request fixes, retests, join requests, reports, billing problems, waiting repairs, Attack surface issues waiting for a decision, stopped trackers and Slack and, in the Odin web app, HackerOne reports waiting for a decision, automation runs waiting for approval, automations that keep failing and dependencies that need review, that are theirs to act on, each with the one reason it reaches them (Yours, Nobody owns it yet, Raised to you, You're an admin, You manage billing). The same list Home shows. Admins also get a summary of items with teammates, and every role is told of a code connection whose sign-in stopped (stoppedConnections). Never changes anything; snooze_attention_items and nudge_attention_owners do.
name: my_attention
title: What needs me
